analysis: Revenue was $4.7B in FY2024, up 43% year over year.

Operating profit was $1.9B, a 40.6% margin (up 20.8 points year over year). Of the extra revenue versus FY2023, 89% reached operating profit, above the 20% margin then. Total costs grew 6% against revenue growth of 43%. Net earnings were $1.6B, up 343% year over year. The effective tax rate was -0.2%.

Operating cash flow was $2.1B (up 98% year over year), 133% of net earnings. Non-cash charges added back $0.45B of depreciation and amortization and $0.37B of share-based compensation. Working capital and other items used $0.30B. Capital expenditures of $4.8M left free cash flow of $2.1B.
